comments.author: UX-admin
comments.html:
"College recruiting had been an important focus for me during my years at Sun. I had only been at Delphix a few weeks when I convinced our CEO that we should recruit from colleges, and left to interview at my alma mater, Brown University."

Why? Why would you recruit from colleges, instead of recruiting experienced engineers, "UNIX graybeards"? What is the motivation behind preferring college graduates over experienced engineers?

comments.author: ahl
comments.html: College recruiting wasn't as the exclusion of other hiring -- it's just that prior to my joining, Delphix had no college hiring. We shoot for a balance: junior folks and experienced engineers who can act as mentors. College recruiting yields very strong engineers and can be programitized; hiring each experienced engineer is a new endeavor.
